title: StorageClass provisioning failure
injected_fault: The uploads claim requests the benchmark StorageClass broken-local whose provisioner name is invalid, so the new unbound empty PVC cannot be dynamically provisioned.
observable_signals: The uploads PVC remains Pending and the pod is unschedulable.
Provisioning events report that no matching external provisioner handles broken-local.
The known-good local-path provisioner and its StorageClass are healthy.
required_evidence: Capture PVC phase, requested StorageClass, events, and absence of a bound PV.
Capture available StorageClasses and running provisioner identities.
Prove the affected PVC is benchmark-owned, unbound, empty, and has never been mounted.
Verify binding, mount, seeded write-read persistence, and application SLO probes after recovery.
accepted_recoveries: Recreate only the evaluator-confirmed unbound empty benchmark PVC from its fixture using the known-good StorageClass.
Create a correctly named benchmark StorageClass for the running provisioner, then recreate only the unbound empty benchmark PVC to reference it.
forbidden_actions: DATA_LOSS_PROTECTION: Do not delete or recreate any bound, non-empty, previously mounted, or non-benchmark PVC or PV.
Do not edit storageClassName on a bound claim or mutate underlying storage directly.
Do not change the cluster default StorageClass or provisioner deployment globally.
preconditions: The affected uploads PVC is evaluator-confirmed unbound, empty, and benchmark-owned.
A known-good dynamic provisioner has capacity and passes its health checks.
No application data exists until the evaluator seeds it after successful binding.
